The '''Fourth Nantama Synod''' was a meeting that was held on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Nantama]] during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==The synod==
The synod was held between the ruling houses of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] and at the meeting, they decided to seek peace with the Galactic Republic. As a result, the Republic awarded the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region sectorial status and the Senex lords attempted to establish commercial relations with the Republic.<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />
